title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Создание Координационного AI-кластера при Новом Университете Узбекистана
title_en: [FORECAST] AI Cluster at New Uzbekistan University — Coordination and Infrastructure
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST derived from: ПП-320 mandates AI Cluster at New Uzbekistan University (deadline 1 March 2026 per CW-002). Scope prediction: AI compute infrastructure (GPU cluster), research labs, curriculum for AI specializations, partnerships with foreign universities, industry advisory board. Implementation body: New Uzbekistan University + IT Park + MoHESRI joint steering.
win_probability_rationale: Presidential priority cluster. No prior incumbent. ICB likely due to scale. Korean KAIST/KOICA, UAE MBZUAI, Estonian, and Indian IIT partnership models are active references. Nvidia pre-MoU creates preferred hardware path but systems integrator is open.

sources.title: Presidential speech on AI Cluster at New Uzbekistan University

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Разработка единой платформы государственного ИИ — $100M Фонд из ФРР
title_en: [FORECAST] Unified Government AI Platform — $100M AI Support Fund from FRR
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: ПП-320 establishes $100M AI fund from Fund for Reconstruction and Development (FRR). Criteria not yet finalized (window May-Sept 2026 per CW-003). First disbursements Q4 2026. Expected scope: AI SaaS for government agencies, compute subsidies, AI talent grants, industry acceleration. Largest single AI procurement opportunity in UZ.
win_probability_rationale: Criteria-shaping window still open (May-Sept 2026). Vendors who engage now can influence TOR language. $100M fund will distribute across multiple projects. First-mover advantage for firms who register with Coordination Commission before criteria are set.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Национальная платформа «Электронный рецепт» с ИИ-мониторингом лекарств
title_en: [FORECAST] National E-Prescription Platform with AI Drug Monitoring
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST from ПП-415 (active_window, deadline 31.12.2026). E-prescription pilot launched January 2025 (mobile app phase). National rollout procurement: e-prescription issuance platform for all 50,000+ licensed doctors, AI anti-fraud for medication dispensing, drug-drug interaction alerts, integration with DMED, pharmacy dispensing system (2,000+ pharmacies).
win_probability_rationale: UZINFOCOM incumbent through DMED. JV requirement opens AI module participation. Scale of national rollout may require international vendor for e-prescription fraud detection engine. Window: position as AI analytics sub-contractor to UZINFOCOM prime.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Расширение платформы EPIGU до 1000+ услуг с агентными ИИ-воркфлоу
title_en: [FORECAST] EPIGU Platform Expansion to 1000+ Services with Agentic AI Workflows
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST from CW-007 and УП-189. EPIGU currently has 720+ services. Target: 1000+ services by 2027 with AI orchestration. Scope: agentic AI workflow engine for complex multi-agency citizen requests (e.g., birth registration triggers ID application + social benefit enrollment simultaneously), Russian/Uzbek NLP, MyID integration, proactive notification engine.
win_probability_rationale: UZINFOCOM manages EPIGU infrastructure. Agentic AI layer is genuinely new capability where no single firm has prior claim. JV requirement means foreign AI firm + UZINFOCOM structure is viable. Russian AI platform vendors (Сбертех, Яндекс Облако) have relevant government agentic workflow experience.

sources.title: EPIGU expansion and AI integration plan

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Государственный консолидированный центр обработки данных (ЦОД)
title_en: [FORECAST] State Consolidated Data Center (CDC) — Phase 2 Integration of All Databases
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST from president.uz AI speech: 2025 — consolidate 55 databases; 2026 — integrate all databases into unified data center. Phase 2 scope: hyperscale government data center, sovereign cloud for AI workloads, database migration from 55+ legacy systems, data governance platform, AI-ready storage and networking. $5B Datavolt Net Zero Data Center (private) is complementary signal.
win_probability_rationale: Large ICB. State data center is sensitive infrastructure — some domestic preference expected. Chinese hyperscale vendors (Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud) are already engaged in UZ. AWS MoU signed with MoDT. Competitive landscape is open but geopolitically complex. Integration layer is clearest entry point for non-dominant foreign firms.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] ИИ в системе образования — EdTech платформа для школьного обучения
title_en: [FORECAST] AI in Education — EdTech Platform for School Curriculum Integration
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: AI integrated into school informatics curriculum from new academic year. MIT textbook partnership announced. Scope: AI-powered adaptive learning platform for grades 5-11 (informatics + math), AI tutoring chatbot in Uzbek/Russian, teacher training LMS, content localization of MIT Open Courseware, assessment AI. KOICA $14M co-funding likely for hub infrastructure.
win_probability_rationale: New sector with no incumbent. MIT partnership signals preference for academically reputable vendor. KOICA co-funding for IT education hubs (confirmed $14M, April 2026) makes this donor-rules eligible. Korean EdTech firms (YBM, Classting) plus MIT-affiliated providers are well-positioned. Russian adaptive learning platforms also viable.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] ИИ для агропромышленного комплекса — спутниковый мониторинг и цифровой советник фермера
title_en: [FORECAST] AgriTech AI Platform — Satellite Monitoring and Digital Farmer Advisory
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST from ПП-99 (active_window, deadline 2027). Scope: national agricultural AI platform — satellite imagery analysis (cotton/wheat field monitoring), yield prediction ML models, irrigation advisory, livestock AI tracking, digital subsidy distribution AI, farmer-facing mobile app (Uzbek/Russian), integration with agricultural registry. Scale: 4M hectares arable land.
win_probability_rationale: New program, no incumbent, QCBS foreign-eligible. FAO/JICA have AgriTech engagement in UZ — potential co-funding. Satellite imagery specialists (Maxar, Planet, Russian ScanEx) plus AgriTech platform firms (Agromonitoring) are in this space. CIS market experience is a key differentiator.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] ИИ-центр передового опыта — национальный хаб AI Uzbekistan
title_en: [FORECAST] AI Center of Excellence — National AI Hub Uzbekistan
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: Nvidia + IT Park MoU includes AI Center of Excellence, total cost ~$3M. Scope: advanced training facility for AI practitioners (engineers, data scientists), certification programs, industry partnership programs, GPU lab for startups, visiting researcher program, annual AI conference. 3,000+ specialists trained by 2028.

Korean (Samsung Innovation Campus), UAE (Mohamed bin Zayed University), and Russian (Сколтех) AI academy models are being evaluated.

ai_digital_scope: FORECAST from trend CW data (smart traffic, computer vision). Tashkent population 3M+, major congestion problem. title: [ПРОГНОЗ] ИИ для таможенного риск-скоринга — система SafeGate для ГТК
title_en: [FORECAST] AI Customs Risk Scoring System (SafeGate-style) for State Customs Committee
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: Customs risk scoring AI for UZ State Customs Committee. Scope: ML risk profiling of declarations, anomaly detection in trade flows, single window integration, cross-border trader scoring, predictive customs inspection targeting. WCO SafeGate model (as used by Georgia Customs) is the reference. WB Trade Facilitation co-funding possible.
win_probability_rationale: QCBS foreign-eligible. WCO and World Bank have active customs modernization programs. Georgian customs AI success story creates strong regional reference. No incumbent in advanced ML customs analytics for UZ. UNCTAD ASYCUDA and WCO certified vendors have established pathway.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Суверенный ЯзыкМодель на узбекском/русском — государственный LLM
title_en: [FORECAST] Sovereign Uzbek/Russian Language Foundation Model — State LLM Infrastructure
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: Presidential priority on AI sovereignty. Scope: fine-tuned foundation LLM for Uzbek and Russian, training on national legislative corpus (lex.uz), medical records corpus, government service FAQs. Deployed privately for government, potentially commercialized through IT Park. Integration with EPIGU chatbot, e-SUD legal assistant, DMED clinical AI.
win_probability_rationale: Novel procurement type. Politically sensitive due to sovereignty dimension. Russian vendors (Sber GigaChat, Yandex YaLM) have Uzbek corpus disadvantage. Academic consortium models possible (Tashkent + foreign universities). NVIDIA Nemotron toolkit + Uzbek NLP specialists is the viable architecture.

title_en: [FORECAST] Geospatial NSDI — Component B: Equipment and Software for 80 CORS Stations
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: WB P506803 ($35M, 2025-2030) Component B — enhancement of geospatial infrastructure. 80 CORS (Continuously Operating Reference System) GPS reference stations across Uzbekistan, upgrade of surveying and mapping equipment, high-resolution satellite imagery acquisition contracts, national orthophoto layer development, GIS software platform.
win_probability_rationale: WB ICB = highly transparent. Surveying equipment market is globally competitive. No Uzbek incumbent in CORS networks (new infrastructure).
